title: Is taking a drop year for competitive exams worth it?
description: The debate weighs whether students should take a year after school to prepare again for competitive examinations such as JEE or NEET.

facts.fact: NTA permits candidates to appear for NEET-UG in multiple years, allowing a second, focused preparation attempt.
A drop year can give students additional time to revise syllabi, practise mock tests and address earlier preparation gaps.
For some students, an improved rank can widen access to preferred colleges and courses.
A repeat attempt does not guarantee admission because seats, cutoffs and competition can change each year.
A drop year can create financial costs and psychological pressure from delayed entry into college or employment.
Students may have credible alternatives, including other colleges, courses, skill programmes or employment pathways.
